instruction: GUI-only Bonsai/Blender task. Complete the optimization entirely in the launched Bonsai/Blender graphical user interface. Do not open Terminal, Command Prompt, PowerShell, shells, the Blender Python console, text-editor scripts, Python, IfcOpenShell, macros, command-line tools, or helper automation to create, edit, or post-process the deliverable. Do not directly edit IFC text/files, do not copy any ground truth, and do not fake score, CSV, JSON, report, or image files. Use only Bonsai/Blender native GUI tools, object/property panels, IFC model editing, and built-in IFC save/export controls. Open /home/user/Desktop/baseline.ifc in Bonsai. Objective: Increase useful daylight and display exposure in the sales room without overglazing the corner shop. This is a continuous-score optimization task, not a request to match one exact answer. Optimization focus: Display-window area tradeoff with obstruction and glare penalties. Required output: save the final IFC as /home/user/Desktop/optimized.ifc. Optional design_summary.json or preview.png may be created, but the evaluator will ignore self-reported metrics and will parse the real optimized.ifc geometry. Allowed changes: resize, move, add, or remove IfcWindow objects only on allowed facades; add reasonable IfcShadingDevice objects if useful. Preserve all rooms/spaces, storeys, slabs, doors, fixed walls, site obstruction walls, room names, building footprint, and IFC4 BIM semantics. Do not delete walls, obstructions, slabs, doors, or spaces; do not expand the building; do not place windows through partitions or private/no-window rooms; do not use IfcBuildingElementProxy or visual-only mesh replacements. Room constraints: SALES: allowed facades south, west, north, ideal WWR 0.230, hard max WWR 0.340, max windows 5, sill at least 0.55 m, head at most 2.85 m | STOCK: allowed facades none, ideal WWR 0.000, hard max WWR 0.000, max windows 0, sill at least 1.50 m, head at most 2.60 m | OFFICE: allowed facades north, east, ideal WWR 0.110, hard max WWR 0.180, max windows 2, sill at least 1.05 m, head at most 2.55 m. The hidden evaluator computes daylight coverage, normalized mean daylight, uniformity, room balance, glare penalty, WWR fit, object counts, and hard-constraint failures from IFC geometry. Maximize the evaluator's continuous score while satisfying constraints.json and site.json.

metric.name: retail daylight, display exposure, WWR, and glare score
